title: Nimble Review (2026)
intro: Social and relationship CRM with Gmail/Outlook sync, contact enrichment, and a single Business plan for teams. This review covers pricing posture, CRM capabilities, limitations, and fit based on first-party research — not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Nimble overall score 6.9/10 from equal-weight CRM criteria. Business $24.90/user/mo billed annually ($29.90 monthly). 14-day trial. No free forever plan.
verdict: Nimble: Choose Nimble when you want a relationship CRM with Gmail/Outlook sync and simple Business pricing. Scores reflect first-party research as of 2026-08-16 — not hands-on product testing.
